Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 2253/2024

Dear Mr. Gokhale,

Thank you for meeting us on 11/07/2024 about your dispute with Everest Pharma Ltd. As we understand it, the employer offered to settle.

Our advice is to negotiate a settlement of gratuity and notice pay. Please collect the salary slips and the gratuity calculation and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹26,50,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
